STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Threadbare Truths

Victim: Sella Venn, adult tailor. Purpose: identify the repaired cuff and establish a physical way through dream geography.

A little bell sounds when the door opens. The shop beyond is orderly in the way a room becomes orderly after somebody has worked through the night: folded garments, pins standing in a cushion, a stool left exactly where a tired person pushed it aside.

The mannequins face the mirrors, not the door. Each wears an unfinished garment. A sleeve pinned too high. A collar waiting to be turned. Ordinary work interrupted by something that did not need the front entrance.

Sella Venn hangs in the fitting space beneath a web of dark thread. It holds her wrists, shoulders and bowed head in a posture meant for somebody measuring a customer. Her feet almost reach the stool.

Between her hands stretches a length of cloth covered in embroidered names. The last needle is still threaded. Every time the bell above the door trembles, the needle moves once, dragging a stitch through a name that is already complete.

In the nearest mirror, Sella is standing on the stool. She is looking directly at the place where you have just stopped.

The body is suspended through supernatural threads; a careful approach can lower it without inflicting more damage. The last name does not magically become a PC's name unless Nella has actually learned and placed it there.

One possible fright

A mannequin wears a coat matching a PC's silhouette. Close inspection shows it is the unfinished travelling coat Perrin ordered, not a perfect copy of the PC's unique magic armour. This preserves uncertainty without invalidating their inventory.

At higher body-horror intensity: some sections of the embroidered shroud are not cloth. Keep the required evidence on ordinary fabric so investigation never requires lingering over the most graphic part.

STILLROOT'S SONG   |   GM DOSSIER

Sella found a rule the dream could not hide

True sequence: Sella left a continuous red guide-thread through a cellar route after a waking-dream incident. She also noticed that Nella's cuff was damaged in a struggle. After repairing it, she recorded the work and began comparing visits with Edda. Nella returned to reclaim that evidence and staged the body with copied sewing gestures.

Examination Finding Inference
Inspect the order book 'Nella: left cuff, three diagonal stitches; paid with apples.' Direct physical identifier, corroborated by Naya's rabbit repair.
Look under the counter A red spool fixed to an iron eyelet; thread runs into a cellar crack A real route marker can survive the dream overlay.
Read the cloth names Ada, Perrin, Edda, Sella, Corven; several older missing villagers The same witness network and older victims.
Check a mirror in silence The reflection becomes accurate Repeatable perceptual interference.
DC 14 Investigation A short length of the same repaired-cuff fabric caught on the door catch Places Nella here after the repair was completed.
DC 15 Arcana The moving needle is a 4th-level animation tether Dispel Magic can end it; cutting the thread also works.

Speak with Dead

Who killed you? 'The woman whose cuff I mended. The grandmother with no family.'

What did she want? 'The order book. And the thread.'

Where does the thread go? 'Past the cellar. Under the well. Keep one end fixed.'

What did you see there? 'Pipes. Three different knots. Something breathing between them.'

How do we follow? 'Do not guess the way. Hold the proof in your hand.'

Countermeasure

A continuous, anchored thread or rope can mark the dream route. The hags may cut or obstruct it through visible actions, but it does not disappear merely because it is useful. A PC holding it automatically recognises a looping corridor and can return to the last anchor point.

Exit leads

The cellar reaches @UUID[Compendium.stillroots-song-journals.gm-journals.JournalEntry.30ded8c4eb53e9e8.JournalEntryPage.b59579d1da9c0126]{the physical descent}. Corven's measurements in the order book point to @UUID[Compendium.stillroots-song-journals.gm-journals.JournalEntry.547690f61d0e4f51]{the crystal formation}. The cuff identifies @UUID[Compendium.stillroots-song-journals.gm-journals.JournalEntry.abd471fb49f0eaa2]{Nella}.
